title: Cell 364
description: A former Stasi prisoner revisits his cell, reflecting on life under dictatorship and democracy.
sound: Clément Chaubet 10-year-old Charlie is proud of his Asperger’s diagnosis
though he sometimes feels different and left out. But he has found two things he loves to do: surfing and dancing. We follow Charlie through ups and downs as he sets himself a very specific goal.
